Dokany optional runtime dependency
==================================

Smart Explorer can install the unmodified official Dokany x64 runtime MSI as
an optional system-wide prerequisite for Windows remote-drive hosting.

Version: 2.3.1.1000 (API 231)
Upstream project: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany
Exact source tag: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/tree/v2.3.1.1000
Source archive: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/archive/refs/tags/v2.3.1.1000.tar.gz
Official binary release: https://github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/releases/tag/v2.3.1.1000

According to the tagged upstream README, dokan2.dll, dokan2.sys, the network
and FUSE libraries, and the installer are licensed under GNU LGPL v3; the
Dokan control program and samples are licensed under the MIT License. Copies
of GNU GPL v3, GNU LGPL v3, and the upstream MIT notice accompany this notice.

Dokany is not part of Smart Explorer and is not removed by the Smart Explorer
uninstaller because it is a shared machine-wide runtime that other programs
may use. Smart Explorer loads the installed user-mode library dynamically.
